content.short: Large LatAm digital bank with accounts, cards and crypto features.
content.description: Nubank, founded in 2013, is one of the world's largest digital banks, serving more than 100 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Its app offers no-fee accounts, credit and debit cards, personal loans, insurance, investments, and business accounts for small entrepreneurs, all wrapped in a design-led mobile experience that helped bring millions of people into the formal financial system. Nubank has also expanded into digital assets, letting users buy, hold, and sell crypto such as Bitcoin and stablecoins, and launched its Nucoin loyalty token on Polygon. By combining mainstream banking at massive scale with growing crypto and stablecoin features, Nubank sits at the intersection of traditional Latin American finance and Web3, competing with incumbents and fintechs alike.
content.meta: Nubank is a leading LatAm digital bank with accounts, cards, and crypto features. Discover Nubank and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
